title: Wall tax
brief: The Iron Golem tumbles across the room toward the right wall. A wall contact produces green gems; the visible top-left counter advances from 32 to 40, and the golem settles upright. The exact player input is not shown. Choose a troll-freeze treatment that makes this physics reward funny and keeps the actual impact plus counter increase readable. Do not claim a victory or deliberate attack. Open brick wall in the upper-middle can hold a reaction face; the lower arena holds the golem and the top-left holds score evidence.
